description: 硬帽檐立领长袖凉感外套，图标列多效主张与双场景机制演示套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for the worn packshot and the detail pair, mint #CBE3D5 claim and trust fields, lotus-pink #EFDDD8 macro field, one bright beach and one misty conifer trail for the two scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright high-key studio light from a large front softbox with a low-power fill card; outdoor scenes run a hard 6000K daylight key with unseen bounce; fabric weave opened only with skimming light
styleLock.surfaceSystem: sand strip #E6DCC9 underfoot in the beach scene, matte lotus-pink board #EFDDD8 for the macro field, seamless white #FFFFFF floor elsewhere
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; one headline slot plus a few short label slots, every rendered word carried by a placeholder and every measurement left as a blank strip
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs inside rounded-square tiles, plus hollow curved airflow arrows in the accent tint; flat, no 3D, no glossy badges, no digits
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 worn angle with the stiff extended brim, stand collar and front zipper always readable; garment never hidden by props; no identifiable face in any frame, head cropped above the jaw or shaded by the brim and face flap; fabric kept matte with visible topstitch
noDrift: no protection index numbers, rating badges or percentage marks
no identifiable model faces or retouched skin
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool mint sun-apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, mint #CBE3D5, lotus-pink #EFDDD8 and deep pine #2C4A41; bright high-key studio lighting from a large front softbox with a low-power fill card, hard 6000K daylight only in the two outdoor scenes, skimming light only for fabric texture; modern geometric sans-serif with headline and label slots kept as placeholders and every value left as a blank strip; thin single-weight line glyphs in rounded-square tiles with flat hollow airflow arrows; real fabric drape with visible topstitch and matte finish; stable slight 3/4 worn angle with brim, stand collar and front zipper readable; generous negative space reserved for copy; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no index numbers or rating badges, no identifiable faces.

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, large front softbox key with a low-power fill card, soft fabric folds and no hard speculars
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, even margins around the silhouette
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce apparel packshot of {product} worn by a generic model whose head is cropped above the jaw so nobody is identifiable. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level camera with the torso turned a slight 3/4 to camera left, front zipper pulled high into the stand collar, the stiff extended brim lifted clear of the hood by one hand and the other sleeve running past the wrist. Bright even high-key studio light from a large front softbox with a low-power fill card on the shadow side, soft fabric folds and no hard speculars. Seamless white background #FFFFFF with no props and no floor reflection. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame with even margins and no extra whitespace reserved for copy. Negative: no identifiable face, no skin smoothing, no chest mark or hang tag, no watermark, no added props, no cropped hem or sleeve, no tinted background.

shots.displayName: 凉感网眼面料掠射微距

shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail is the subject, only one blank strip under the round inset

Camera pressed in close and looking down at a high 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field at f/2.8 with the nearest stitches sharp and the far weave falling off. Skimming light sweeping in from camera left to open up the weave relief, soft falloff toward the right. Background lotus-pink matte board #EFDDD8 with one small round inset holding the stylised twisted-yarn illustration. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace since the detail is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented fibre diameter or gram-weight figures, no water droplets implying wetness, no plastic-looking textile, no glossy sheen, no hands in frame, no extra text, no watermark.

shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce detail pair for {product}: two matched tight-zoom panels in one layout, the upper panel showing a hand sliding into the clean-cut side pocket and the lower panel showing the extended cuff with its thumb opening. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The upper panel shot straight-on at hip height and the lower panel shot from a clean 90-degree side profile, both kept at the same scale. Even soft studio light with a low fill so the topstitch, the pocket welt and the cuff bar-tack stay legible and no hard speculars appear on the fabric face. Background seamless white #FFFFFF panels separated by a hairline gutter. One generic hand per panel with short natural nails and no jewellery. The first label slot beside the upper panel reads 「{callout_3}」 and the strips beside the lower panel stay blank. Each panel keeps the garment at 55-60% of its own area with no extra whitespace inside the panels. Negative: no extra or fused fingers, no glossy manicure, no face in either panel, no invented pocket depth, no mismatched scale between panels, no overlapping text, no watermark.

shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen built around {product}, the garment shown front-on at a slight 3/4 on an invisible mannequin at the left of the layout so the stand collar, front zipper and hood with its stiff brim all read clearly. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level camera for the panel itself. Even high-key studio light from a large front softbox with a low fill card, and a soft contact shadow under the hem so nothing floats. One empty circular seal outline sits at the upper right with nothing drawn inside it and a three-row parameter strip runs below it with every value cell left blank, no digits and no unit marks anywhere. Headline slot reading 「{selling_point_4}」 at the top right, one short label slot reading 「{callout_4}」 inside the empty seal frame, the remaining row labels kept as identical blank strips. The garment occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous negative space across the right 35% for copy. provenance.notes: 6 张源图逐图事实：001 白底真人上身，一手掀起帽檐硬片，立领全拉链、长袖过腕；002 冷蓝天光底，极低仰角举臂撑帽，左侧竖排六枚圆角方格细线图标加短标签，右下圆形锯齿印章带防护等级数值，底部圆角面板两行英文要点；003 海滩半身为主体，肩背织带背包，左侧两枚圆角内嵌图（纱线凉感芯体渲染图、布面点状网眼微距）各配两行英文要点；004 云雾山林背景，背面 45 度，帽身拉起加硬檐与遮面片，背片叠加三条半透明气流箭头，左下细线圆形图标加两行英文；005 绿林虚化背景加下半部斜切网眼布特写带，人物一手掀檐；006 浅底双格细节（手插侧袋、袖口指扣特写）加顶部标题条。品类判定依据：源图字样与画面均为运动与户外语境（跑步训练搭配、海滩与山林徒步、指扣袖口与遮面帽型），故落 运动户外/服饰 而非 女装/外套；源平台类目字样与源标题仅作检索线索，不作为判定依据。变体闸门核对：六图构图与漏斗角色互不重复，无多数同构图仅换色的色卡陈列，故正常转化。与库内既有同品类模版的查重：既有那一套骨架是白底正面加白底背面加海岸全身加帽顶发孔微距加三格细节加空白尺码表加深色平铺收口，产品形态为可拆帽檐与帽顶发孔；本套源图为仰角图标列多效主张、凉感纱线与网眼双内嵌机制图、山林背面气流示意、双格细节与空白背书收口，无尺码表也无平铺收口，帽型为一体硬檐加遮面片，属实质分镜差异，故转化；为区隔把色板由晴空蓝系改为薄荷冷绿加深松绿与浅藕粉，slug 追加 ASIN 后缀。已剥离内容：源品牌字标与胸前小标、原平台店铺字样、全部模特面容与身份（改为颈上裁切、背角或帽檐与遮面片投影遮挡）、六图全部英文原句文案、圆形印章内的防护等级数值与锯齿角标、帽檐加长尺寸数值与换算值、纱线与网眼内嵌图的英文功效描述；以上一律以 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位或改为空印章框与空白条位。产品一律以 {product} 占位，场景、构图、光位与排版结构为可复用部分。
